hero.headline: Full-stack development from UI to infrastructure.
hero.sublinePre: I build and ship complete web products — interface, API, database and deployment. I also work with AI as an engineering instrument rather than a shortcut:
hero.sublinePost: lets me deliver in stacks I was never formally taught, at the same standard as the ones I was.

method.title: AI-Augmented Delivery
method.intro: AI is the reason a one-person project can carry the scope of a team's. It is not the reason the code is correct — that is still process. This is how I combine the two.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a Full Stack Web Developer with a degree in Web Application Development (DAW) and over a year of hands-on experience at Servibyte S.L. I build interfaces that don't just work but feel right, and back them with APIs and infrastructure that hold up.
about.p2: What changed my range is how I work: I write the specification first, then use AI to move fast inside it, and verify everything before it ships. That is what let me take a product live on Next.js and Supabase — a stack I was never taught in class — without lowering the bar on quality.
about.p3: I work with independent judgment, learn quickly, and I'm at my best on a team that reviews each other's work.
